title: Enter the Abyss (miniquest)
start: The Mage of Zamorak at the beginning of the above-ground River Lum in the Wilderness (roams levels 4-7).

recommended.t: Unlocking the Ardougne and Edgeville lodestone
Wicked hood for quick transportation to the Wizards' Tower

rewards.t: A small pouch (able to carry 3 pure essence or rune essence)
Increased stock in the Battle Runes shop

steps.t: If you have PVP enabled bank all your equipment, gear and items so that you don't lose anything to player killers.
North of Edgeville jump the Wilderness wall and run north to the tip of the river Lum and speak to the Mage of Zamorak without wearing Saradomin or Guthix equipment. [Chat: Accept]
Go to the Temple of Zamorak in southeast of Varrock.
Without wearing Saradomin or Guthix equipment, speak to the Mage of Zamorak. [Chat: 2 Where do you get your runes from? › 1 Yes]
Continue the dialogue where the mage explains how to use the scrying orb.
With the scrying orb in the backpack go to Aubury's Rune Shop in southeast of Varrock.
Head to the Wizard's Tower south of Draynor and go to the floor 3.
Choose the "teleport" option on Archmage Sedridor in the south.
Head to Wizard Cromperty who is located in the blue-tiled house in northeast of Ardougne.
Choose the "teleport" option on Wizard Cromperty.
Go to the Temple of Zamorak in southeast of Varrock.
Without wearing Saradomin or Guthix equipment, talk to the Mage of Zamorak twice. The step requires 2 backpack space.
After the completion of the miniquest, speak to the Mage of Zamorak a third time to unlock the Abyss.
